Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, I put together a short set of SKU options that map to the mix you described (20 prod seats, 8 sandbox seats, heavy batch embedding jobs). The attached Redwood_SKUs_v2.xlsx has three rows: a) immediate upgrade to Pro (allows 2x throughput), b) blended Dedicated-lite + hosted overflow, and c) a phased swap (seat credits + feature bundles).

Key notes up front:
- Seat-swap credit: we can apply credits for active annual seats toward the Dedicated commitment on a 1:0.6 basis for the first year (example: 20 prod seats => credit equal to 12 committed slots).
- Feature bundling: Observability 90-day retention is included in the Dedicated-lite SKU; advanced evals/quality monitoring is an add-on.
- Pricing: the workbook includes list price + an illustrative 12-month commit discount band.

Can you confirm the timeline you’re targeting for transitioning the prod traffic? If you want, I can translate the three options into a single-page commercial summary for procurement.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You flag the preferred SKU by EOW (we’ll draft formal quote + SOW).
2) If procurement needs standard terms, Priya — I can route our procurement checklist & SOC2 pack.
3) We can schedule a 30-min sync next week to walk the commit math.

Attaching: Redwood_SKUs_v2.xlsx (pricing + SKU logic)

3) Bundles: we need long-term retention for audit (12+ months). Your note said 90 days for Dedicated-lite. Can we get 12 months in the bundle?

Also — can you provide a simple two-column matrix showing: SKU option vs what’s included (throughput, retention, included evals, seat credit rules)? That’ll make procurement’s life easier.

Alex —

Thanks for the great questions. I’ve summarized the three options below into a compact matrix (see attached PDF for the one-pager):

Option A — Immediate Pro upgrade (hosted -> Pro):
- Throughput: 2x baseline; good for short-term latency gains
- Retention: 90 days included
- Seat credit: not applicable (billed per seat/month)
- When to pick: if you need velocity improvement with minimal infra changes

Option B — Dedicated-lite + overflow hosted:
- Throughput: predictable Dedicated slots with automatic overflow into hosted during spikes
- Retention: 90 days included; 12 months add-on available at a 6% ARR uplift
- Seat credit: 1:0.6 for active annual seats applied to first-year commitment
- When to pick: steady production traffic, desire for cost predictability

Option C — Phased seat-swap (12-month commit with seat credits):
- Throughput: Dedicated baseline based on committed slots
- Retention: we include 12 months if total ARR >= $75k; otherwise 90 days
- Seat credit: 1:0.6, floor = 8 credits max in year one
- When to pick: you want credit applied to existing spend and a clear path to Dedicated

Additional clarifications:
- The 1:0.6 program is our standard mid-market conversion program; we can scale the effective rate for larger multi-year commits (we’re open to discussing adjustments if you move to a 24-month commit).
- Legacy seats remain usable for 60 days after go-live during the phased swap; after that we reconcile usage and finalize credits.

Action items for procurement:
- Priya: if Net30 + PO is acceptable, I’ll prepare a formal quote and PO-ready invoice.
- Alex: pick preferred Option (A/B/C) and any must-have retention SLAs by EOW.
